flows.name: Ordinary processing
steps: Check trackable-target eligibility
Open configured Source Scope read-only
Resume from durable high-water with bounded overlap
Parse/canonicalize messages and structured participants
Match accepted operational identities/aliases
Persist only protected matched/collision content plus independent links
Create idempotent owning-domain proposals where applicable
Advance coverage/high-water only through durably committed work

flows.name: Targeted historical backfill
steps: Detect newly accepted target earlier than current coverage or operator request
Restrict to affected Source Scope/folders/identities/range
Run durable background job with normal identity/idempotency rules
Merge newly found canonical messages/links without resetting unrelated high-water
Record explicit partial/unknown coverage when source cannot be read completely

flows.name: Deep Scan
steps: Present explicit scope/range/resource-impact/coverage preview
Require operator confirmation
Run durable background job
Preserve canonical identity and existing links
Never claim unreadable intervals complete

flows.name: Domain proposal acceptance
steps: Canonical Communication/link creates reviewed proposal
Operator or approved policy selects disposition
Owning domain receives exact proposal/source identities and proposed facts
Owning domain freshly validates current state and commits mutation/audit
HLD-10 records proposal decision/provenance without becoming lifecycle authority

flows.name: Terminal unlink and orphan grace
steps: Receive accepted SR terminal event or separately confirmed RFC cascade
Freeze minimized terminal communication summary
Remove only that target's direct links
If any protected dependency survives, Communication remains retained
If none survive, enter Orphaned-Pending-Purge with due time based on last dependency removal
Restored protected dependency cancels pending purge

flows.name: Due purge
steps: Housekeeping selects due orphan candidate
Open transaction and freshly revalidate all protected links/proposals/correction/export holds
Cancel purge if any dependency exists
Otherwise remove reconstructable retained content/content-derived search material
Persist non-reconstructable minimized purge evidence and frozen terminal summaries
Never mutate external PST/OST, existing exports/backups or domain history

flows.name: MSG provenance
steps: Originating domain generates immutable local draft identity/template/recipient snapshot
Export remains operator-managed artifact
No sent Communication is created
Later PST/OST discovery creates normal canonical sent message
Optionally link draft as provenance without identity merge

scheduler_rules: one combined fetch-and-match pipeline per Source Scope
default interval sixty minutes but configurable/disableable within LLD bounds
at most one run per Source Scope
overlapping ticks coalesce and at most one catch-up remains pending
orphan housekeeping runs independently from mail fetching
cancellation/restart preserves last committed coverage and never fabricates success
